title: Spotify access token in a Bearer header
summary: A synthetic access token after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a Web API request, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map.
rationale: Spotify documents the header form Bearer followed by the access token, a token valid for 1 hour. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, so the scheme in the carrier is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The Bearer scheme is generic, so the attribution stays generic; the extent is the value after the scheme and excludes the closing quote.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value after an explicit Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a Spotify Web API request is treated as a credential and covered whole. Spotify documents the Bearer header form and the 3600 second lifetime (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic authorization attribution are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: To use the access token you must include the following header in your API calls: Authorization: Valid access token following the format: Bearer <Access Token>. Note that the access token is valid for 1 hour (3600 seconds). After that time, the token expires and you need to request a new one.
